title: Double the Side: 4 Copies Fit Inside
description: Two blue squares sit side by side. The left square has corner vertices labelled "A", "B", "C", and "D", a solid blue fill, and a tick mark on its bottom and right sides. A label underneath reads "AB = 1 unit". The right square has corner vertices labelled "E", "F", "G", and "H", with two tick marks on its bottom side and two on its left side. One horizontal dashed line and one vertical dashed line cut it into four equal pale blue square cells. Below it, a label reads "EF = 2 units".

title: Baudhāyana's Square on the Diagonal
description: An upright square with solid dark outlines and a blue fill has corners labelled 'A', 'B', 'C', and 'D'. A reddish-purple diagonal joins corner 'A' to corner 'C'. Built outward on this diagonal is a tilted square with dashed outlines, a light amber fill, and corners labelled 'A', 'F', 'E', and 'C', centred on corner 'B'. A right-angle symbol marks the top corner 'F'. Three callout boxes with leader lines read 'AC is the diagonal' pointing to the diagonal, 'original square' pointing to the blue square, and 'square on the diagonal' pointing to the tilted square.

title: 2 Triangles Against 4: The Square on the Diagonal
description: A geometric diagram shows an upright square ABCD and a tilted square ACEF sharing side AC. Diagonal AC splits square ABCD into a blue right triangle ADC and a green right triangle ABC. Extended horizontal and vertical lines from vertex B divide the tilted square ACEF into four congruent right triangles: the shared green triangle ABC, and three amber triangles ABF, BEF, and BCE. A right-angle symbol marks corner B in triangle ABC. Vertex labels read "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", and "F". A rounded box above reads "ACEF has four triangles", and a rounded box below reads "ABCD has two triangles".

title: A Sequence of Squares: 2, 4 and 8 Triangles
description: Three square panels sit in a row, linked by rightward arrows. Each panel shows a dashed grid outline of an outer square. In the first panel, a lower-left blue square with vertices labeled 'A', 'B', 'C', and 'D' is cut by a dashed diagonal into 2 right triangles, labeled '2 triangles' below. In the middle panel, a tilted amber square with vertices 'A', 'F', 'E', and 'C' is cut by dashed perpendicular lines into 4 right triangles, labeled '4 triangles'. In the third panel, the full green outer square with vertices 'S', 'R', 'Q', and 'P' is cut by dashed lines into 8 right triangles, labeled '8 t...

title: The Midpoint Square Is 4 of 8 Triangles
description: An upright square with dark blue outlines has corners labelled "A", "B", "C", and "D", and midpoints labelled "R" at the top, "Q" on the right, "P" at the bottom, and "S" on the left. A tilted square with vertices at these midpoints is filled in amber. A solid vertical line connects R and P, and a dashed horizontal line connects S and Q, intersecting at the centre with a small square right-angle mark. Together, they divide the shape into eight congruent triangles: four amber triangles inside the tilted square and four white triangles at the outer corners. Below, a label reads "4 out of 8 trian...

title: Folded Paper PQRS: Corners to the Centre
description: Three panels show how folding a square paper forms a smaller square. In 'Step 1: mark midpoints', an upright square has amber dots at midpoints labeled 'R' at the top, 'Q' on the right, 'P' at the bottom, and 'S' on the left, connected by a dashed diamond. In 'Step 2: fold the corners in', lines connect 'R', 'Q', 'P', and 'S', with four curved arrows pointing inward from the grey corner flaps. In 'Step 3: PQRS forms', the dashed original outline encloses an amber square PQRS, divided into four right triangles by lines connecting opposite vertices.

title: The square on the diagonal is double: c² = 2a²
description: A teal isosceles right triangle PQS has a right-angle mark at vertex P, vertical side PS labelled "a", horizontal side PQ labelled "a", and reddish-purple hypotenuse SQ labelled "c". Square PQRS consists of triangle PQS and an adjacent triangle SRQ. Standing on SQ is a tilted amber square SQVU with top vertex U and right vertex V. Dashed grey lines through vertex R split square SQVU into four congruent pale amber right triangles, with a right-angle mark at R. Centred below the geometry, three stacked blue boxes read "Area of PQRS = a²", "Area of SQVU = c²", and "c² = 2a²".

title: The square on the hypotenuse of the 1 by 1 triangle
description: A teal unit square PEAR has vertices labelled 'P', 'E', 'A', and 'R', with square right-angle marks at 'P' and 'A', and each side labelled '1'. A pink diagonal connects 'R' and 'E'. Extending from 'A', dashed lines reach vertices 'T' above and 'S' to the right, forming a dashed amber tilted square REST partitioned into four congruent triangles. A slanted purple-bordered badge to the left reads 'RE = √2 units'. Below sit two blue cards reading 'Area of PEAR = 1 square unit' and 'Area of REST = 2 square units'. description: Three horizontal number lines, each divided into ten equal intervals, zoom in on √2. The top line runs from "1" to "2", with blue boxes "1² = 1" and "2² = 4" below, and a green segment between "1.4" and "1.5" marked by a pink dot labelled "√2". Grey dashed lines zoom to the second line from "1.4" to "1.5", where a green segment spans "1.41" to "1.42" around another pink dot labelled "√2". The bottom line runs from "1.41" to "1.42", highlighting "1.414" to "1.415" with a third "√2" dot. title: Two Squares Combine on the Hypotenuse
description: On the left, under 'Two squares', a blue square 'ABCD' sits beside a plus sign '+' and a larger yellow square 'EFGH', followed by a right arrow, labelled 'Area ABCD' and 'Area EFGH'. On the right, under 'Squares on a right triangle', a right triangle 'PQR' has a pink right-angle mark at 'R'. Square 'RPTS' in blue attaches to leg 'PR', labelled 'Area RPTS', while square 'RQUV' in yellow hangs below leg 'RQ', labelled 'Area RQUV'. Along hypotenuse 'PQ', a tilted green square with vertices 'P', 'X', 'W', 'Q' is labelled 'Area RPTS + Area RQUV', above 'PQ is the hypotenuse'.

title: Baudhāyana's Figure: T, U, V, W and X
description: A geometric figure shows two joined rectangles at the base and a tilted square above them. Four light blue right triangles labeled "T", "U", "W", and "X" surround a central amber five-sided region labeled "V". The tilted square is composed of "T", "U", and "V". Four right angles are marked by small squares with diagonal slashes. Eight angle arcs mark the corners of the tilted square: four pink single arcs and four green double arcs. Four angles are labeled "x". Side lengths are marked with "a" at four places, "b" at two places, and two segments are highlighted with brown lines.

title: Same Pieces, Same Area: T + U + V and V + W + X
description: Two figures sit side by side, separated by a right-pointing grey arrow. On the left, a tilted square is divided into three pieces: two light blue right-angled triangles labeled "T" and "U" along the upper edges, and a yellow five-sided polygon labeled "V" filling the lower portion. On the right, two joined squares sharing a flat baseline are divided into three pieces: a light blue right-angled triangle labeled "W" at the bottom left, an identical yellow five-sided polygon labeled "V" in the center, and a light blue right-angled triangle labeled "X" at the bottom right. title: Two Cuts Turn Two Squares Into One
description: Two panels are connected by a rightward arrow. On the left, a smaller blue square and a larger amber square stand joined along a bottom baseline. Two dark cut lines run from a point on the baseline to the top-left corner of the blue square and the top-right corner of the amber square, creating three pieces. The left panel is labeled "a" on the left, "b" on the right, "a", "b - a", and "a" along the bottom, and "c" beside each cut line. On the right, the same three pieces form a tilted square, with two adjacent sides labeled "c".

title: Same Right Triangle, Three Ways Round
description: Three congruent right-angled triangles sit in a horizontal row, each with teal shorter sides, a reddish-purple hypotenuse, and a grey square right-angle symbol. In the first triangle, vertical side '3 cm' and horizontal base '4 cm' meet at corner 'C', with hypotenuse '5 cm' connecting top vertex 'A' to vertex 'B'. In the middle tilted triangle, shorter sides '3 cm' and '4 cm' meet at corner 'C' on the left, with hypotenuse '5 cm' running between vertex 'A' above and vertex 'B' below. title: A 13 m Ladder Against a Wall
description: A grey horizontal ground segment and a grey vertical wall meet at a right angle marked with a blue right-triangle outline at the base. A light brown wooden ladder with twelve rungs leans against the wall, with its foot on the ground and its top touching the wall. A blue rounded box to the left of the ladder is labelled "13 m". A blue bracket along the ground spans from the foot of the ladder to the wall, with a blue rounded box below it labelled "5 m". A vertical blue bracket along the wall spans from the ground to the top of the ladder, labelled "h".

title: Odd Numbers Build Squares
description: Four square grids of unit cells sit in a row, each above a rounded box with an equation. The first panel shows 1 blue cell labeled '1 = 1²'. The second panel shows a 2 by 2 square with 1 blue cell and 3 amber cells forming an outlined L-shape, labeled '1 + 3 = 2²'. The third panel shows a 3 by 3 square with 1 blue cell, 2 amber cells, and 6 green cells enclosed by a dark outline, labeled '1 + 3 + 5 = 3²'. The fourth panel shows a 4 by 4 square with 1 blue cell, 3 amber cells, 5 green cells, and an outlined L-shape of 7 pink cells, labeled '1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 4²'.

title: The Lotus Stem Before and After the Breeze
description: A cross-section of a lake shows light blue water over a brown bed. A teal vertical lotus stem extends from root 'R' on the bed through surface point 'P' to a pink lotus flower, with the segment above water labelled '1'. The underwater stem from 'R' to 'P' is labelled 'x'. An amber stem extends diagonally from 'R' to point 'T' on the water surface, where a second pink flower rests. The segment between 'T' and 'P' is labelled '3', and the diagonal stem is labelled 'x + 1'. The shaded light green triangle 'RPT' has a square right-angle mark at 'P'.
